items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I know the fella called Candy Dan, played guitar, lived on, lived in the street between Pardis and Pardis.

ctx.x: Oh, you didn't think about that guy's name, that guitar player across from the school there,

played Spoonful? Oh, um, let me see. Dan. His first name was Dan. Dan. Dan, Dan Thomas, Dan Thomas, I believe it was. Dan, I think it was Thomas. He's a Candy Dan. Candy Dan. Candy Dan. That's his name. That's new to me. Candy Dan. Anybody tell you about, say, you ask me about Candy Dan, you could go up around that district and ask anybody, the old ones that didn't know of, I know the fella called Candy Dan, played guitar, lived on, lived in the street between Pardis and Pardis. Same Spoonful. There's nothing…
That's all tore up, isn't it? Yeah. Candy Dan. Candy Dan. That's him.
